title: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who travels to New Phyrexia with Wrenn and finds Nissa compleated.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who plans to bond with the Invasion Tree and guide it, and is seized by Nissa.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: Wrenn's tree companion, torn apart by Phyrexian Nissa.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker and Mirran Resistance leader who devises a plan to fling Chandra and Wrenn to the tree.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran with no metal on her who supports the plan and hope.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who helps the resistance, saying he serves no one and that Norn stifles the fires of creation.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
entities.description: A compleated version of Nissa, with four arms and root-like features, who serves Elesh Norn and tries to convert Chandra.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler who anticipated the resistance.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker taken by Norn after being lost.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time mage whom Wrenn expects to help.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Chandra's late mentor.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Chandra's dead friend.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: A past tyrant Chandra recalls.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane Chandra and Wrenn invade.

entities.name: The Invasion Tree
entities.description: The towering Phyrexian World Tree that Wrenn plans to bond with.

entities.name: Overlook platform
entities.description: A platform across a chasm where Chandra confronts Nissa.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city of Kaladesh used as a size comparison.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: The Mirrans
entities.description: The Mirran resistance that creates a distraction for the plan.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A protective remedy of which only a little remains.

entities.name: The God-Eternals
entities.description: Immortal beings that Chandra says were smaller than the Invasion Tree.

events.summary: Chandra and Wrenn arrive on New Phyrexia and find a bright landscape dominated by a vast Invasion Tree.
events.quote: Chandra can't comprehend how tall the Invasion Tree is.

events.summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
events.quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

events.summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
events.quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

events.summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
events.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

events.summary: Chandra realizes the platform belongs to Nissa and agrees to the plan.
Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
events.quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

events.summary: Chandra lands hard on the tree and Wrenn prepares to bond while centurions form around them.
events.quote: Plates along the tree shift and reform.

events.summary: Centurions speak with one woman's voice and spears pin Chandra to the tree while Phyrexian Nissa attacks Wrenn.
events.quote: Green magic crackles around her metallic body, her four arms all acting as conduits.

events.summary: Chandra recognizes the Phyrexian figure as Nissa.
events.quote: Even with two new arms grafted onto her body

events.summary: Nissa tears Seven apart and drops Wrenn, saying she no longer feels pain.
events.quote: I no longer feel any pain.

events.summary: Nissa reveals the Mother of Machines sent her to stop Chandra, whose plan has already failed.
events.quote: The Mother of Machines sent me to stop you.

events.summary: Nissa offers to save Chandra by joining Phyrexia, and Chandra sees a vast Phyrexian army across the bridge.
events.quote: There is an army on the other side of the bridge.

events.summary: Chandra realizes Norn knew about the resistance all along and that it was a trap.
events.quote: The whole time they'd been here, she knew what was going on.

events.summary: Nissa has copper branches seize Wrenn, whom she calls a fine guardian for Realmbreaker.
events.quote: You will make a fine guardian for Realmbreaker,

events.summary: Wrenn signals Chandra as flames glow within her, unnoticed by Norn.
events.quote: Flames flicker within her pale body.

events.summary: In Nissa's own voice, she tells Chandra she misses her and begs her to come, and Chandra is tempted.
events.quote: Please, come with us. I miss you.

events.summary: Chandra refuses, and Nissa's face turns to rage.
events.quote: I miss you so much. But I can't. I'm sorry.

events.summary: Chandra drives her fiery fist into the branch, blowing the platform apart and flinging herself and Nissa away while Wrenn clings to the tree.
events.quote: Chandra ducks below Nissa's slicing arm and drives her fiery fist into the branch itself.
